subject.title: fix(agents): pass attemptNumber instead of apiKeyIndex to retry callbacks (#102938)

question: Should the public rotation callback gain `apiKeyIndex` and `attemptNumber` while retaining `attempt` as a supported field, or should `attempt` enter an explicitly versioned deprecation lifecycle?
rationale: The callback is reachable through a shipped plugin SDK entrypoint, so automation cannot decide whether an existing public field should be deprecated or eventually removed.

options.title: Keep `attempt` supported
options.body: Add the explicit fields but remove the deprecation annotation, preserving the shipped property indefinitely unless a later approved migration changes that policy.

options.title: Approve a deprecation lifecycle
options.body: Retain the annotation only with documented replacement guidance, compatibility tests, a target major version, and an explicit removal owner.

recommendation.title: Keep `attempt` supported
recommendation.body: Add the explicit fields but remove the deprecation annotation, preserving the shipped property indefinitely unless a later approved migration changes that policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The generic rotation helper's introduction and subsequent adjacent maintenance make this the strongest available owner for its public callback contract.
